task: Design critique of the Cast tab (Director's Console) found real bugs and design gaps. Fixed all 5 Critical items and all 4 Warning items in one contained pass: nested <button> invalid HTML in CharacterRow, keyboard-unreachable TierHeader, hover-only kebab menu, missing empty-cast state (per recorded owner decision), lucide-only icon rule violations (🖌/🚫 emoji), duplicate chapter-nav save semantics (partial — see flow_impact), an over-weighted ANALYSIS strip, sub-scale rail typography + a too-narrow rail, and 'paint' vocabulary leaking into user-facing copy.

frontend/src/pages/Book/studio/CastPalet.summary: CRITICAL FIXES: (1) CharacterRow's outer <button> no longer wraps ColorSwatchPicker — the row is now a plain card <div> containing ColorSwatchPicker (its own button) as a SIBLING of a new `<div role="button" tabIndex={0}>` label region (avatar+name+voice+count+chevron) that handles select/disarm via onClick + onKeyDown (Enter/Space); no button is ever nested inside another button. (2) TierHeader now has `tabIndex={0}` and an onKeyDown handler firing its onToggle on Enter/Space (still skipped when `alwaysOpen`). (3) The Promote/Delete kebab (ActionMenu) for tier-2 temp characters is now ALWAYS rendered (never conditionally unmounted) — opacity 0.4 at rest, 1 on hover/menu-open/keyboard-focus (new onFocus/onBlur-driven `labelFocused` state), so Tab reaches it. (4) Added a single empty-cast-state card (replacing the three stacked tier headers) shown whenever tier1+tier2+tier3 total to zero characters, per design-docs/workflows/chapter-editor-modes.md §13 decision #2 — 'No cast yet — this chapter reads in the narrator's voice', an 'Add character' button (wired to the existing onCreateTempCharacter flow — see flow_impact for why this isn't Casting Call), and a plain-text pointer to the Casting Call tool. (5) Replaced the 🚫 emoji appended to unavailable voice variants with a lucide `Ban` icon. WARNING FIXES: rail width raised 180px -> 230px (stops truncating 'Use Project Default (Dark F...'); every literal font-size below the --type-micro floor (0.55/0.58/0.62/0.65/0.66rem) raised to `var(--type-micro)`; footer copy 'paint a voice...'/'choose a cast member to start painting' replaced with plain instructional language ('select a character, then click sentences to assign').

frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/compone.summary: CRITICAL: replaced the 🖌 emoji in the floating 'painting: X' / 'clearing' chip with a lucide `Brush` icon; also dropped the word 'painting' from the visible copy ('Selected: X — click sentences to assign'). WARNING (#6, partial): registers Cast's existing `hasUnsavedChanges` (title/text edit) signal with `useDirtyGuard()` from DirtyGuardContext.tsx, mirroring WriteTool's pattern exactly, so DirectorsConsole's own rail-tab switching now prompts before discarding an unsaved chapter text edit made while in Cast mode. This does NOT cover `ChapterWorkspaceHeader`'s separate prev/next chapter-nav arrows (outside Director's Console, navigates without saving) — see flow_impact.

frontend/src/pages/Book/studio/AnalysisS.summary: WARNING #7: the four labeled stat blocks (Chars/Words/Sentences/Segments, each with a bold `--text-primary` value + separate label) plus the 'Analysis' eyebrow were collapsed into a single quiet caption string ('956 chars · 174 words · 9 sentences · 9 segments · ~57s') at `var(--type-caption)` / `var(--text-muted)`, with the analyzing spinner/Info icon inline. The 'ACTION REQUIRED: N unresolvable' badge and the auto-fixed success badge are unchanged (still prominent warning/success colors) — only the reference-only stats were demoted.

frontend/src/theme/components.css.summary: `.studio-analysis-strip` demoted from a bordered/shadowed card to a plain low-chrome container; added `.studio-analysis-strip__caption` (var(--type-caption), var(--text-muted)); removed the now-unused `__eyebrow`/`__stats`/`__stat`/`__value`/`__value--accent`/`__label`/`__divider` rules that backed the old per-stat card blocks.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Book/studio/Ca.summary: Updated the 3 kebab-menu tests to stop relying on `fireEvent.mouseEnter(rowBtn.parentElement)` (the kebab is now always mounted, so hover is no longer required to reach it) and added a new 'CastPalette — design critique fixes' describe block: no <button>-in-<button> DOM check, TierHeader Enter/Space keyboard toggling, the empty-cast-state card (rendered + hidden when zero characters, tiers hidden, Add character wired to onCreateTempCharacter), and no 🖌/🚫 emoji in rendered output.

New file: renders CastPalette WITHOUT mocking ColorSwatchPicker (unlike CastPalette.test.tsx, which stubs it to a plain div) so the nested-button assertion exercises the real ColorSwatchPicker button structure, not a stub. R1-style revert-check: this test would fail against the pre-fix CharacterRow (button wrapping ColorSwatchPicker's button).

frontend/tests/unit/pages/ChapterEditor/.summary: Added a test confirming the 'Selected: ...' chip renders a `svg.lucide-brush` icon and that the rendered output contains no 🖌 emoji character.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Book/studio/An.summary: Updated assertions from the old per-stat-block queries (`getByText('956')`, `getByText('Sentences').previousElementSibling`, etc.) to regex matches against the new single caption line ('956 chars', '174 words', '9 sentences', '9 segments', '~57s').

flow_impact: No public contract changes. Two items intentionally scoped down from the critique's literal wording, both noted to the requester: (a) the empty-cast state's 'Casting Call' pointer is plain text, not a working link/callback — CastingCallPlaceholder (registry.ts) is still an unwired 'coming soon' stub, and DirectorsConsole's active-tool state is internal (tool bodies render with zero props, INV-1), so wiring a real cross-tool switch from here would require new plumbing out of scope for this pass; (b) item #6 (duplicate chapter-nav save semantics) is only partially closed — Cast's `hasUnsavedChanges` is now registered with DirectorsConsole's existing DirtyGuardContext (protects rail-tab switching), but `ChapterWorkspaceHeader`'s own prev/next arrows (a sibling component outside Director's Console) still navigate without saving; making those arrows save first was judged too invasive for this pass and is a known, separate, deferred gap. Do-not-touch files (Booth/Revise/Write bodies, DirectorsConsole/index.tsx, DirtyGuardContext.tsx) were left untouched — DirtyGuardContext was read-only reference, not edited.
